data.name: Rohaan
data.gender_notes: Rohaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is content, satisfied, and at peace. The name Rohaan carries the meaning “Content, Contented” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rohaan usually hope their child will grow to embody content, contented and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a soul that has found inner peace and contentment
data.etymology: Rohaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Content, Contented.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: روهان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم روهان مشتق من الجذر العربي ر-و-ح، ويعني الروحانية أو الارتفاع في المعنى، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "والروح جعلناها رمزا للخلق"، ويحمل الاسم دلالات روحية ومعنوية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: روهان
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام روہان عربی جڑ ر-و-ح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے روحانیت یا معنویت، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اور معنوی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں، جہاں یہ نام روحانی اچھائی اور بلند مرتبے کی علامت ہے.

in_hindi.name: रोहान
in_hindi.meaning: रोहानी, मानसिक, या ऊंचे स्तर का
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम रोहन अरबी जड़ र-व-ح से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है روحانية या उच्च स्तर, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहरी आध्यात्मिक और मानसिक महत्व रखता है, खासकर भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, जहां यह नाम आध्यात्मिक अच्छाई और उच्च स्तर की प्रतीक है.

in_pashto.name: روهان
in_pashto.long_meaning: د روهان نوم د عربي جذر ر-و-ح څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د روحانیت یا لوړه کچه معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتني قومونو په دودیزو کړاوونو کې ژوره روحاني او معنوي اهميت لري، او د روحانيت او لوړ مقام نښه ده.

in_english.name: Rohaan
in_english.meaning: Spiritual, high-level, or elevated in meaning
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rohaan originates from the Arabic root r-و-ح (r-w-ḥ), which conveys the meanings of spirituality, soul, or breath. This root is mentioned in the Quran in several verses, indicating its significance in Islamic tradition. The name Rohaan symbolizes spiritual elevation, high moral character, and is often associated with positive personality traits such as compassion, empathy, and enlightenment. Across various Muslim cultures, Rohaan is cherished for its deep spiritual connotations and aspirational qualities.

The name Rohaan signifies an individual who is content, at peace, and satisfied with their life circumstances. In a societal context, such a person is looked upon with admiration and respect, as they possess a valuable quality that is often sought after in personal relationships and communal harmony.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, the concept of finding peace and contentment within oneself is deeply interconnected with spiritual growth and closeness to God (Allah). The name Rohaan holds great spiritual significance as it symbolizes an individual's pursuit of inner peace and tranquility, which is seen as a precondition for experiencing divine guidance and love. Through the name Rohaan, one can be reminded of the importance of living in the present moment and cultivating a sense of gratitude and responsiveness to God's blessings in their daily lives. Ultimately, the name Rohaan encourages individuals to strive towards a deeper understanding of their spiritual selves and to be present in their own lives, while being mindful of the presence of God in their existence.
